finding: A SQLite inbox stores deduplicated, read-state notices from bound Run transitions, approvals, semantic changes and local reminders. Approval reconciliation uses a durable rotating cursor over bounded pages of 1,000 unread candidates, so a full page of live approvals does not permanently starve later stale notices. Four inbox domain tests and two host reconciliation tests pass, including a 1,001-notice restart fixture. Native navigation, actual sleep/resume and product-level quietness journeys are untested.
conclusion_proposal: Keep deferred until AZ-072 durable trigger integration and product inbox wiring are complete.
next_action: Exercise native reminder/approval click-to-task and unchanged-state quietness; verify multiple-read backlog behavior and complete AZ-072 trigger integration.
verification_gaps: No native product-level unchanged-state or navigation fixture
Approval expiry/restart covered by a local fixture only
